    pgPolicy("membership_tenanted_tenant_scope", { as: "restrictive", for: "all", to: ["public"], using: sql`((SELECT rebase.uid() IS NULL)) OR ((SELECT string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin'])) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."memberships" "_ex0" WHERE ("_ex0".org_id = "public"."membership_tenanted".org_id) AND (("_ex0".user_id)::text = (SELECT rebase.uid()))))`, withCheck: sql`((SELECT rebase.uid() IS NULL)) OR ((SELECT string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin'])) OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."memberships" "_ex0" WHERE ("_ex0".org_id = "public"."membership_tenanted".org_id) AND (("_ex0".user_id)::text = (SELECT rebase.uid()))))` }),
])).enableRLS();

export const orgMembers = pgTable("org_members", {
    org_id: uuid("org_id").notNull().references((): AnyPgColumn => orgs.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    person_id: integer("person_id").notNull().references((): AnyPgColumn => people.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    role: orgMembersRole("role").default(sql`'member'`).notNull(),
    seat: integer("seat").unique(),
    joinedAt: timestamp("joined_at", { withTimezone: true, mode: 'string' }),
    touchedAt: timestamp("touched_at", { withTimezone: true, mode: 'string' }).default(sql`now()`),
}, (table) => ([
    primaryKey({ columns: [table.org_id, table.person_id] }),
    index("org_members_person_id_ix_2ee80f6").on(table.person_id.asc().nullsLast()),
    pgPolicy("org_members_default_admin_read", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("org_members_default_admin_write_insert", { as: "permissive", for: "insert", to: ["rebase_admin"], withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("org_members_default_admin_write_update", { as: "permissive", for: "update", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))`, withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("org_members_default_admin_write_delete", { as: "permissive", for: "delete", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("org_members_default_edge_read", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["public"], using: sql`(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."orgs" "_ex0" WHERE "_ex0".id = "public"."org_members".org_id)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."people" "_ex1" WHERE "_ex1".id = "public"."org_members".person_id))` }),
])).enableRLS();

    post_id: integer("post_id").notNull().references((): AnyPgColumn => posts.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    tag_id: uuid("tag_id").notNull().references((): AnyPgColumn => tags.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
}, (table) => ([
    primaryKey({ columns: [table.post_id, table.tag_id] }),
    index("post_tags_tag_id_ix_1b3d736").on(table.tag_id.asc().nullsLast()),
    pgPolicy("post_tags_default_admin_read", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("post_tags_default_admin_write_insert", { as: "permissive", for: "insert", to: ["rebase_admin"], withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("post_tags_default_admin_write_update", { as: "permissive", for: "update", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))`, withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("post_tags_default_admin_write_delete", { as: "permissive", for: "delete", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("post_tags_default_edge_read", { as: "permissive", for: "select", to: ["public"], using: sql`(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."posts" "_ex0" WHERE "_ex0".id = "public"."post_tags".post_id)) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."tags" "_ex1" WHERE "_ex1".id = "public"."post_tags".tag_id))` }),
])).enableRLS();

    pgPolicy("uuid_target_default_admin_write_insert", { as: "permissive", for: "insert", to: ["rebase_admin"], withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("uuid_target_default_admin_write_update", { as: "permissive", for: "update", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))`, withCheck: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
    pgPolicy("uuid_target_default_admin_write_delete", { as: "permissive", for: "delete", to: ["rebase_admin"], using: sql`(SELECT (rebase.uid() IS NULL) OR (string_to_array(rebase.roles(), ',') && ARRAY['admin']))` }),
])).enableRLS();

export const appItemsRelations = drizzleRelations(appItems, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "owner": one(uuidTarget, {
        fields: [appItems.ownerId],
        references: [uuidTarget.id],
        relationName: "app_items_ownerId"
    })
}));

export const authorsRelations = drizzleRelations(authors, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "posts": many(posts, { relationName: "posts_authorId" }),
    "profile": one<typeof profiles, [AnyPgColumn<{ tableName: "authors" }>]>(profiles, {
        fields: [authors.id],
        references: [profiles.authorId],
        relationName: "profiles_authorId"
    })
}));

export const commentsRelations = drizzleRelations(comments, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "post": one(posts, {
        fields: [comments.postId],
        references: [posts.id],
        relationName: "comments_postId"
    })
}));

export const companyTranslationsRelations = drizzleRelations(companyTranslations, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "company": one(companies, {
        fields: [companyTranslations.id],
        references: [companies.id],
        relationName: "company_translations_id"
    })
}));

export const derivedFkRelations = drizzleRelations(derivedFk, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "category": one(tags, {
        fields: [derivedFk.categoryId],
        references: [tags.id],
        relationName: "derived_fk_categoryId"
    })
}));

export const membershipTenantedRelations = drizzleRelations(membershipTenanted, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "org": one(tenantOrgs, {
        fields: [membershipTenanted.orgId],
        references: [tenantOrgs.id],
        relationName: "membership_tenanted_orgId"
    })
}));

export const membershipsRelations = drizzleRelations(memberships, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "org": one(tenantOrgs, {
        fields: [memberships.orgId],
        references: [tenantOrgs.id],
        relationName: "memberships_orgId"
    })
}));

export const orgsRelations = drizzleRelations(orgs, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "members": many(orgMembers, { relationName: "members" })
}));

export const orgMembersRelations = drizzleRelations(orgMembers, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "org_id": one(orgs, {
        fields: [orgMembers.org_id],
        references: [orgs.id],
        relationName: "members"
    }),
    "person_id": one(people, {
        fields: [orgMembers.person_id],
        references: [people.id],
        relationName: "orgs"
    })
}));

export const peopleRelations = drizzleRelations(people, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "orgs": many(orgMembers, { relationName: "orgs" })
}));

export const postsRelations = drizzleRelations(posts, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "author": one(authors, {
        fields: [posts.authorId],
        references: [authors.id],
        relationName: "posts_authorId"
    }),
    "editor": one(authors, {
        fields: [posts.editorId],
        references: [authors.id],
        relationName: "posts_editorId"
    }),
    "parent": one(posts, {
        fields: [posts.parentId],
        references: [posts.id],
        relationName: "posts_parentId"
    }),
    "comments": many(comments, { relationName: "comments_postId" }),
    "tags": many(postTags, { relationName: "tags" })
}));

export const postTagsRelations = drizzleRelations(postTags, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "post_id": one(posts, {
        fields: [postTags.post_id],
        references: [posts.id],
        relationName: "tags"
    }),
    "tag_id": one(tags, {
        fields: [postTags.tag_id],
        references: [tags.id],
        relationName: "posts"
    })
}));

export const profilesRelations = drizzleRelations(profiles, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "author": one(authors, {
        fields: [profiles.authorId],
        references: [authors.id],
        relationName: "profiles_authorId"
    })
}));

export const tagsRelations = drizzleRelations(tags, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "posts": many(postTags, { relationName: "posts" })
}));
